Other refusals from this same method -- 5th failure or already-locked
account 403, expired password 403, unknown identifier caught as
UserNotFoundException and flattened to 401 Invalid credentials, anything
else 500. All of them still answer with the Token DTO, which has no
GlobalExceptionHandler and never appear on this path.
Afterwards the same JWT is accepted two ways -- JWTAuthenticationFilter.resolveToken() reads the
Authorization Bearer header first, then falls back to JwtCookieService.resolveToken() and the
khi_auth_token cookie. Either carrier then goes through TokenService.isTokenBlacklisted() on every
